ask: Should the download card stay as "On this device" until people leave the Map, so taps don't miss?
problem: On a new device, tapping a passage on the Map sometimes did nothing. The nightly test hit this.
found: When the download finished, the card above the list vanished and the list jumped up. A tap made at that moment started on one spot and ended on another, so it opened nothing. I made it happen every time here.
changed: When the download finishes, the card stays put. It turns green, says "On this device" and keeps its height, so the list never moves. It goes away when you leave the screen.
why: Things should not move under a finger; keeping finished items in place is the usual fix. I checked for a late server answer first, like LAN-252. It was not that. The test is unchanged.
touches: The download card on the Map and in Settings. No new text to translate.

pictures.label: Before: the card vanished, the list jumped up, and the held tap opened nothing
After: the card turns green and stays, the list does not move, and the tap opens the passage

linear.comment: Found the cause. On a new device the Map shows "Downloading this language" above the list. When the last passage arrived, that card vanished and the list jumped up about 125 px. A tap in progress then landed on empty space: the click counted, but nothing opened. On a phone the same jump can open the row below. The nightly machine was busy enough to catch it, and I reproduced it every time here by holding a tap while the download finished. It was not a late server answer like LAN-252. Fix: the finished card stays in place as "On this device", at the same height, until the screen is left. The test is unchanged. PR: https://github.com/genesis-ai-dev/langquest-next/pull/419
